meta.name: context-driven-development
meta.description: Creates and maintains project context artifacts (product.md, tech-stack.md, workflow.md, tracks.md) in a `conductor/` directory. Scaffolds new projects from scratch, extracts context from existing codebases, validates artifact consistency before implementation, and synchronizes documents as the project evolves. Use when setting up a project, creating or updating product docs, managing a tech stack file, defining development workflows, tracking work units, onboarding to an existing codebase, or running project scaffolding.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在项目里维护一个 conductor/ 文件夹，存放产品、技术栈、工作流程、任务清单四类文档。它能从零搭建项目，也能从已有代码提取上下文；实现功能前会核对文档是否一致，项目变更时同步更新文档。
howto.when: 当你要求搭建新项目、创建/更新产品文档或管理技术栈等场景时触发。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude keeps a conductor/ folder with four context docs: product, tech-stack, workflow, tracks. It scaffolds new projects or extracts context from existing code, validates docs before coding, and syncs them as the project changes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you set up a new project, create/update product docs, or manage the tech-stack file, etc.
